text: 桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D（DSH 网页端与 Desktop 桌宠组件）：为 DeepSeek Harness 加入随任务状态变化的 VRM 3D 宠物。插件在 DSH 客户端覆盖层显示宠物，并由主机侧同步会话边界状态、读取模型和动作目录；Desktop 环境还可启动置顶透明悬浮窗。用户可切换 VRM/glTF 模型、配置状态动作与表情、导入模型和动作、与宠物互动并玩内置弹球小游戏，也可配置预设或 AI 碎碎念。适合想在 DSH 工作时获得可自定义桌面宠物反馈的用户；图形环境需支持 WebGL2，独立窗口需要 Electron，AI 台词可选接入 DSH 模型或自定义兼容服务。

VRM Pet 3D adds a task-reactive 3D companion to DSH. It renders in the client overlay or a transparent Desktop window, supports custom models and motions, pet interactions, a mini-game, and optional AI chatter. WebGL2 is needed; the separate window uses Electron.
我想让 DSH 工作时有个会跟着任务状态变化的 3D 桌宠。
有没有能在 DSH 里显示 VRM 角色的宠物插件？
想把自己的 VRM 模型导入桌宠并换着看。
能不能给空闲、工作中和等待确认状态分别播放不同动作？
我想要一个置顶透明的独立宠物窗口，鼠标还能穿透空白区域。
怎么让桌宠按我点击的部位说不同的碎碎念？
想在模型设置里导入自己的动作包并配置表情和凝视。
有没有能和桌宠玩弹球小游戏的 DSH 扩展？
I want a 3D companion that reacts to my DSH task state.
Can I use my own VRM model and motion pack for a desktop pet?
桌宠 3D 的功能「任务状态联动」：主机监听 DSH 的 session/event 边界并发布状态，客户端订阅后展示空闲、工作、等待确认、完成等宠物状态。
桌宠 3D 的功能「应用内与独立悬浮窗」：客户端把宠物注入 shell.overlay；Desktop 可另开透明置顶窗口，窗口不可用时可使用应用内显示。
桌宠 3D 的功能「模型导入」：从文件或上传内容导入 VRM、GLB、glTF，插件把模型副本保存到自身存储供目录和选择页使用。
桌宠 3D 的功能「动作目录」：读取内置及用户导入的动作目录，生成动作目录供宠物按状态播放配置动作。
桌宠 3D 的功能「AI 碎碎念」：用户选择 DSH 模型服务或 OpenAI 兼容接口后，宠物可按人格、状态提示或互动部位生成一句气泡台词。
桌宠 3D 的功能「鼠标互动与动作菜单」：用户可右键切换模型、播放随机舞蹈、进入小游戏、重载模型或切换重力；点击和拖动可与宠物互动。
桌宠 3D 的功能「弹球小游戏」：从宠物菜单进入小游戏，玩家移动挡板击球打碎砖块并收集米饭；游戏核心维护关卡和游戏状态。
桌宠 3D 使用 AI 碎碎念时，会将人格、状态提示和互动提示发送给所选模型服务；自定义服务地址及可选 bearer key 由用户配置。
桌宠 3D 的弹球小游戏启动时会请求 GitHub 上的关卡 JSON；请求失败时继续使用随插件附带的两关数据。
AI chatter sends persona and interaction prompts to the chosen model; endpoint and key are user configured.

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · 桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D：为 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** 添加一只随任务状态活动的 3D 桌宠。支持应用内显示，以及 DSH Desktop 上独立的透明悬浮窗；任务进行、等待确认、完成或出错时，宠物会显示对应状态并播放配置的动作。

自带两款模型和 VRMA 动作包，安装后即可使用。可导入自己的模型，设置动作、表情、视线和物理效果，也可以让宠物说预设台词或使用 AI 生成碎碎念。

[安装与使用](#安装) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-vrmpet3d/issues) · [MIT 许可证](LICENSE)

no runtime dependencies · works offline

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · 功能：| 功能 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 两种显示方式 | 应用内宠物；Desktop 端自动开启独立悬浮窗，支持置顶和透明区域鼠标穿透 |
| 任务状态联动 | 空闲、工作中、等待确认、完成、出错与离线；空闲保持 idle，不自动进入休眠 |
| 模型 | VRM 1.0 / 0.x，兼容普通 glTF/GLB；人体动作播放需要 VRM 骨架 |
| 动作 | 自带 VRMA 动作包，可按状态配置循环、单次、速度、表情、口型和凝视 |
| 跳支舞 | 右键随机播放一支舞蹈；播完、双击或开始工作时结束 |
| 吃白饭小游戏 | 右键进入桌宠弹球，吃完米饭通关；自动保存、暂停恢复倒计时、任务消息提醒，内置两关并静默更新关卡 |
| 互动 | 点击与长按部位触发表情和碎碎念；拖动、缩放、旋转视角、视线跟随和弹簧骨物理 |
| 碎碎念 | 内置台词、自定义台词，或使用 DSH 模型 / OpenAI 兼容接口生成 AI 台词 |
| 导入 | 模型以文件导入、动作包以文件夹导入，复制到插件存储后不依赖原路径 |
| 界面语言 | 全部界面中英双语，默认跟随系统 / DSH 自动识别；「通用设置 → 显示与外观」和初次引导欢迎页各有一个语言选择（自动 / 中文 / English） |

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · 运行要求：- 已在 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2** 上验证；其他版本尚未验证，不代表无法使用。本项目是 DSH 插件，不能作为独立应用运行。
- 支持 WebGL2 的图形环境。独立悬浮窗需可用的 Electron 运行时，由启动器从 DSH 安装目录复用；无法启动时回退到应用内显示。
- 无需安装运行时 npm 依赖。默认台词和模型动画可离线使用；AI 碎碎念取决于所选服务的网络与额度。

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · 安装：请使用本仓库的 **main 分支**安装。项目尚未发布到 npm。

1. 在 DSH 插件管理器中添加本仓库；支持 GitHub 包来源时，使用：

```text
   github:drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-vrmpet3d#main
   ```

2. 也可以[下载 main 分支 ZIP](https://github.com/drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-vrmpet3d/archive/refs/heads/main.zip)，解压后在插件管理器中添加包含 `package.json` 的文件夹，或填写 `link:<插件文件夹的绝对路径>`。
3. 确认插件已启用，然后重启 DSH。更新插件后也请重启，确保宿主代码和页面代码使用同一版本。

请先停用其他占用同一桌宠显示位置的插件，例如 `dsh-plugin-fatfish-pet`、`dsh-plugin-whale-pet`。卸载时从插件管理器移除本插件。

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · 首次使用：首次引导会依次配置偏好模型、桌宠界面和 AI 碎碎念。可稍后配置，也可在 **通用设置 → 其他 → 重新运行引导** 再次打开。

- **切换显示方式**：Desktop 的通用设置最上方可选“内置宠物”或“自动”；自动优先使用独立悬浮窗。右键菜单也可以切换。
- **切换模型**：右键 → 切换模型，点击缩略图；可拖入自己的模型文件，加载进度结束后再继续切换。
- **设置动作**：通用设置 → 状态与动作。默认映射、表情和播放方式已随动作包提供，可以自行修改。
- **设置台词**：通用设置 → 碎碎念。选择内置、自定义或 AI 来源；AI 模式需要先选择可用服务和模型。
- **设置表情与部位**：右键 → 当前模型参数设置。模型结构不同，可用表情、部位和弹簧骨链也会不同。

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · 鼠标操作：| 操作 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| 点击 / 原地长按 | 触发部位互动与碎碎念，保留正在播放的动作 |
| 左键拖动 | 移动宠物；开启对应界面的重力后，松开可触发抛掷和落地 |
| 滚轮经过宠物 | 调整宠物及其文字大小 |
| 滚轮经过文字 | 单独调整文字大小 |
| 右键拖动 | 旋转观察视角 |
| 右键点击 | 打开菜单：显示切换、模型切换、跳舞、重载、设置、重力和隐藏等 |
| 双击 | 结束当前跳舞 |

本项目的 MIT 许可证不替代模型作者的授权；其他用途仍以作者原始发布页的条款和另行授权为准。

模型支持 `.vrm`、`.glb`、`.gltf`，动作支持 `.vrma`；不支持 PMX/PMD 或 VMD。普通 glTF/GLB 没有 VRM 人体骨架时，不能播放 VRMA 人体动作。自带模型与动作使用 Brotli 压缩存储，加载时自动解压。

导入内容与配置保存在 DSH profile 的插件存储目录中。移除导入只删除插件持有的副本，不删除原文件。随包动作的默认设置按文件名解析，不依赖其他机器上的模型或动作 ID。
桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · AI 与隐私：宠物通过任务状态、会话标识和计时信息判断当前状态，不需要读取会话正文、工具参数或附件。启用 AI 碎碎念后，所配置的人格、状态提示词和部位信息会发送给你选择的 AI 服务；费用与数据处理规则由该服务决定。

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · 常见问题与反馈：- **没有宠物**：检查插件管理器里是否仍已启用，重启 DSH，并确认未被其他桌宠插件占用显示位置。
- **没有独立窗口**：在通用设置中选择“自动”；若运行时不可用，仍可使用内置宠物。
- **模型不播放动作**：确认使用 VRM 模型，状态下选有动作，并开启模型动作。反馈时请附上完整错误提示。
- **AI 不说话**：检查台词来源、服务、模型和访问额度；可以先切回内置台词确认气泡显示正常。

请通过 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-vrmpet3d/issues) 提交问题，附上 DSH 版本、操作系统、内置/外置显示方式、复现顺序与预期结果。请勿上传 API Key 或私人会话内容。

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · English：Add a 3D desktop pet to **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. The pet follows task states and can appear inside the app or in a separate transparent floating window on DSH Desktop. It shows the current state and plays its assigned motion while a task is running, waiting for confirmation, completed, or has failed.

Two models and a VRMA motion pack are included. You can import your own models, configure motions, expressions, gaze and physics, and let the pet speak preset lines or generate AI chatter.

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · English：[Installation and usage](#installation) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-vrmpet3d/issues) · [MIT license](LICENSE)

> This is an early release and is still being improved. 3D rendering uses GPU and memory. When reporting a problem, include your DSH version, display mode and reproduction steps.

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · Features：| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Two display modes | In-app pet, or an automatically opened floating window on Desktop with always-on-top and transparent-area click-through support |
| Task state tracking | Idle, working, waiting for confirmation, completed, failed and offline; idle stays in the idle state and does not automatically sleep |
| Models | VRM 1.0 / 0.x and regular glTF/GLB; humanoid VRM bones are required for character motions |
| Motions | Included VRMA pack with per-state loop, one-shot, speed, expression, lip-sync and gaze settings |
| Dance | Right-click to play a random dance; it ends when the motion finishes, on double-click, or when work starts |
| Interaction | Click or hold body parts for expressions and chatter; drag, resize, rotate the view, follow the pointer and use spring-bone physics |
| Chatter | Built-in or custom lines, or AI-generated lines using a DSH model or an OpenAI-compatible service |
| Import | Import models as files and motion packs as folders. Imported files are copied into plugin storage and no longer depend on their original paths |
| Language | The whole interface is Chinese and English, auto

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · Requirements：- Verified with DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2**. Other versions have not been verified; this does not mean they cannot work. This is a DSH plugin and cannot run as a standalone application.
- A graphics environment with WebGL2. The floating window requires an available Electron runtime, which the launcher reuses from the DSH installation. If it cannot start, the pet falls back to the in-app display.
- No runtime npm dependencies are required. Built-in lines and model motions work offline. AI chatter depends on the selected service's network access and usage quota.

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · Installation：Install from this repository's **`main` branch**. The project is not published on npm yet.

1. Add this repository in the DSH plugin manager. If it accepts GitHub package sources, use:

```text
   github:drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-vrmpet3d#main
   ```

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · Installation：2. You can also [download the `main` branch ZIP](https://github.com/drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-vrmpet3d/archive/refs/heads/main.zip), extract it and add the folder containing `package.json` in the plugin manager, or enter `link:<absolute path to the plugin folder>`.
3. Make sure the plugin is enabled, then restart DSH. Restart after updates as well so the host and page code use the same version.

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · Installation：Disable other plugins that use the same pet display position first, such as `dsh-plugin-fatfish-pet` and `dsh-plugin-whale-pet`. Uninstall this plugin through the plugin manager.

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · First run：The first-run guide configures your preferred model, pet display and AI chatter. You can finish setup later, or reopen it from **General Settings → Other → Run setup guide again**.

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · First run：- **Choose a display mode:** On Desktop, select “Built-in pet” or “Automatic” at the top of General Settings. Automatic mode prefers the separate floating window. You can also switch modes from the right-click menu.
- **Choose a model:** Right-click → Switch model, then select a thumbnail. You can also drop in a model file; wait for loading to finish before switching again.
- **Configure motions:** General Settings → States and motions. Default state mappings, expressions and playback settings are included and can be changed.
- **Configure lines:** General Settings → Chatter. Choose built-in, custom or AI lines. AI mode requires an available service and model.
- **Configure expressions and body parts:** Right-click → Current model settings. Available expressions, body parts and spring-bone chains depend on the model.

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · Mouse controls：| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Click / hold in place | Trigger body-part interaction and chatter while preserving the current motion |
| Drag with left button | Move the pet; when gravity is enabled for that display, release to throw it and let it land |
| Scroll over the pet | Resize the pet and its text |
| Scroll over text | Resize the text only |
| Drag with right button | Rotate the view |
| Right-click | Open the menu for display and model switching, dancing, reloading, settings, gravity, hiding and more |
| Double-click | End the current dance |

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · BlueFatFish model attribution and authorization：The project's MIT license does not replace the model author's authorization. Other uses remain subject to the terms on the original release page and any separate authorization from the author.

Models support `.vrm`, `.glb` and `.gltf`; motions support `.vrma`. PMX/PMD and VMD are not supported. Regular glTF/GLB files without a VRM humanoid skeleton cannot play VRMA character motions. Bundled models and motions are stored with Brotli compression and decompressed automatically when loaded.

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · BlueFatFish model attribution and authorization：Imported files and settings are stored in the plugin storage directory in the DSH profile. Removing an import deletes only the plugin's copy, not the original file. Default settings for bundled motions are resolved by filename and do not depend on model or motion IDs from another machine.

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · AI and privacy：The pet uses task state, session identifiers and timing information to determine its current state. It does not need to read conversation text, tool arguments or attachments. When AI chatter is enabled, the configured personality, state prompt and body-part information are sent to the AI service you select. That service determines its own fees and data handling rules.

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · Troubleshooting and feedback：- **The pet is missing:** Check that the plugin is enabled, restart DSH, and make sure another pet plugin is not using the same display position.
- **The floating window is missing:** Select “Automatic” in General Settings. The in-app pet remains available if the runtime cannot start.
- **The model does not move:** Confirm that you are using a VRM model, that a motion is assigned to the current state, and that model motions are enabled. Include the full error message when reporting the issue.
- **AI is silent:** Check the line source, service, model and usage quota. Switch to built-in lines to confirm that the speech bubble works.

桌宠 3D · VRM Pet 3D README · Troubleshooting and feedback：Report issues through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-vrmpet3d/issues). Include your DSH version, operating system, display mode, reproduction steps and expected result. Do not upload API keys or private conversation content.
